summary.en: UTF-8 string package that extends Lua-compatible string routines with Unicode-aware operations.
summary.zh: 在 Lua 兼容字符串接口基础上补充 Unicode 能力的 UTF-8 字符串处理包。

en: Load this package with `require("lua-utf8")`; it intentionally avoids clashing with Lua 5.3+ built-in `utf8`.
zh: 请通过 `require("lua-utf8")` 加载本包；它刻意避免与 Lua 5.3+ 内建 `utf8` 模块冲突。
